A SENSE OF PLACE

The Lawrenceville
connection.

Lawrenceville’s courthouse square anchors a downtown of dining, shopping and performance destinations. The Lawrenceville Arts Center is home to Aurora Theatre, giving an evening here a clear focal point. A chauffeur plan can connect a hotel, dinner and the performance without leaving the return journey to chance.

A LOCAL DETAIL
Can we include dinner before a Lawrenceville performance?

Provide the restaurant, reservation time and performance venue together. Discuss an hourly service if the vehicle is needed across the evening, including the planned return.
